Read the passage:

Artificial intelligence is reshaping industries from healthcare to finance, but its impact on employment remains hotly debated. Optimists argue that AI will create more jobs than it eliminates by generating new industries and enhancing productivity. Historical precedent suggests technological disruptions have ultimately benefited workers—the Industrial Revolution, despite initial dislocations, led to unprecedented prosperity. However, skeptics point out that AI differs fundamentally from previous technologies. Its ability to perform cognitive tasks means it can replace not just manual laborers but white-collar professionals—lawyers, doctors, accountants. Moreover, the pace of AI advancement may outstrip society's ability to retrain workers. While new jobs will emerge, they may require skills that displaced workers cannot easily acquire. The crucial question is not whether AI will transform employment, but whether the transition will be managed humanely.

What is the author's primary purpose in this passage?
option_a: To prove that AI will eliminate more jobs than it creates
option_b: To argue that historical precedents accurately predict AI's impact
option_c: To present different perspectives on AI's employment impact
option_d: To advocate for immediate restrictions on AI development
option_e: To criticize optimists who underestimate AI's dangers
